**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a buffet-style tasting plate. It holds a roast chicken leg quarter, a fresh rice-paper roll with shrimp, a piece of cucumber, a breaded fried chicken drumstick and a sesame/cereal bar drizzled with chocolate.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white rimmed dinner plate, about 27 cm across. Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- roast chicken leg (thigh and drumstick, with skin and bone)
- shrimp rice-paper roll
- cucumber piece
- breaded fried chicken drumstick
- sesame bar with chocolate drizzle

No visible oil or sauce pools.

**STEP 4 - Area:**

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Chicken leg | 9% | 51 cm² |
| Rice-paper roll | 4% | 23 cm² |
| Cucumber | 3% | 17 cm² |
| Breaded drumstick | 4% | 23 cm² |
| Sesame bar | 5% | 29 cm² |

Total coverage is about 25%, which fits the mostly empty plate.

|---|---|---|

| Item | Grams × kcal/100 g | kcal |

| Chicken leg | 130 g × 200 | 260 |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 316 g and 645 kcal. That is plausible for a sparse tasting plate whose main item is a whole chicken leg.
